edytor.pv: Live preview – does not move the real blind
edytor.d_kol: Colour of the solid (blackout) stripes, as in day-night fabric collections; “custom” = any colour.
edytor.d_sia: Colour of the sheer stripes. “Like solid” = a lighter shade of the stripe colour.
edytor.d_ram: Colour of the frame and sashes. Colours with grain are wood-look veneers.
edytor.d_sk: Number of window sashes. With two, each sash can have its own blind.
edytor.d_okn: Shown when a contact sensor reports the window open. Move a slider to see it in the preview.
edytor.d_kr: The ▲ and ▼ buttons move the blind by a small step. Quick positions are the percentage buttons.
edytor.slh: A fixed mullion stays in the frame. A moving one is part of the left sash, so with both sashes open the middle is free.
edytor.obr: Motor speed: {0} rpm → full travel approx. {1} s
edytor.obr0: This blind does not report motor speed
edytor.obrA: – assuming 30 s (the card will learn it, or use calibration).
edytor.kalh: Manual stopwatch: click, then press “Arrived” when the blind reaches the end. Best from fully open to fully closed.
edytor.wz1: Pick a blind or a blind group. Groups are at the top.
edytor.wz2: The card checked your home by itself:
edytor.wz3: Pick a ready-made look. You can change everything later in 🎨 Look.
edytor.wzS0: The motor does not report speed – the card will learn the time (or calibrate in ⏱)
edytor.wzC0: No contact sensors found in this room (add them later in 🪟)
edytor.wzP0: Weather: from the internet (Open-Meteo, home location)
edytor.globh: Save this look (colours, frame, window, buttons, options) as the default for all blind cards, including new ones. Each card can still change it.
edytor.gSave: 🌍 Save as default for all cards
edytor.gIle: Saved globally: {0} settings. All cards use them.
edytor.gBrak: No global settings – cards use the defaults.
edytor.auto_czujniki: Find window contact sensors in this room automatically
edytor.czA: 🔎 Detected automatically (left / right): {0}. Manual choice above takes priority.
edytor.czA0: 🔎 No contact sensors found in this blind’s room – pick them above if you have any.
edytor.klamki: Window handles (turn when tilted or opened)
edytor.krs: One tap ▲/▼ moves the blind by
edytor.akh: Note: this moves the real blind. It goes fully up, fully down and up again. The card measures the time and saves it.
edytor.ak0: Moving the blind to the top…
edytor.akrpm: The motors report their speed, so the card already computes the time ({0} s). No calibration needed ✔
edytor.aktm: The blind did not report the end of travel. Use the manual stopwatch below.
edytor.uchwyty: Handles on bottom rails (move one sash)
edytor.osobno: Dragging on the glass moves one sash only

f.name: Name
f.tlo: Photo of the view (e.g. /local/window.jpg – file in www folder)
f.czujnik_lewe: Left sash contact sensor (or the only one)
f.tryb_lewe: When open, the left sash is…
f.tryb_prawe: When open, the right sash is…

zr: HA entity, internet if there is none
